text:
ria: quick RFC follow-up: the last onboarding noisy alert was caused by subtle tokenization drift after the converter changed unk-handling. golden benches missed it because samples didn't hit the rare-merge case. we should design a tiny incremental prober that focusses on drift-sensitive inputs before heavy benches.

sam: agreed. idea: a two-stage intake probe. stage 1: deterministic checksum chain (tokenizer fingerprint + small probe-set hash) run inline. stage 2: if checksum diverges, run a focused mini-prober (10-50 sequences) that targets rare-token merges, longest-prefix splits, and kv-cache boundary cases.

asha: love the staged approach. mini-prober should be configurable per-model family. e.g., Llama variants need split-token probes; t5-like models need bpe-merge checks. keep mini-prober runtime under 200ms.

leo: ops constraints: keep stage 1 <20ms and emit a single structured event. events: {event: "intake_checksum", model_ref, result:[OK,DRIFT], probe_id}. For DRIFT, attach a 256B base64 compact diff with the top 3 offending token sequences.

ria: tradeoffs: stricter defaults reduce bad canaries but increase manual triage. propose descriptor flag: "drift_policy": "auto"|"strict"|"lenient". auto learns from historical FP rate and adapts threshold. default auto for hosted, lenient for lab.

sam: implementation notes: checksum chain = sha256(tokenizer_spec + serialized_probe_set) truncated to 64 bits. Mini-prober selection uses stratified sampling over seq-len and token-frequency buckets. include a rare-token-score metric.

asha: for lineage, we should record converter-version and tokenizer-rewrite-hash so we can attribute drift to a specific transform. also record a suggested mitigation: "apply tokenization shim" or "use fallback-model-variant" if available.

leo: rollout: 1) implement checksum emitter + schema, 2) run mini-prober in shadow for 2 weeks at 5% intakes, 3) add adaptive thresholds, 4) flip primary. collect metrics: canary-noise, manual-triage-rate, mini-prober-run-rate, average added-latency.

ria: add UI for one-click "accept despite drift" that logs reason and increments a trust counter for that model. safety: require escalation for >3 accepts within 24h.

onboard-bot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/boards/ONBOARD-4909 and scheduled shadow window 4812400000-4814080000.

sam: I'll sketch a prototype lambda and the checksum util.

asha: I'll build the mini-prober templates for bpe & sentencepiece and unit tests for determinism.

leo: I'll own telemetry schema and the UI accept flow.

ria: great. Sync in 1h to review prototype traces.

sam: ack.
